jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: Senior title and a legal-adviser role requiring a legal qualification and substantial experience, both of which the candidate lacks. Atrocity-accountability work is a perfect interest match, but the level and qualification are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board seat is a senior, expert-level appointment, not an entry-level paid role, and demands a substantial professional track record the candidate does not have. Field fit is strong but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Internship - Speculative Opportunities
jobs.reason: Internships are excluded as a matter of policy, and this is additionally speculative with no concrete vacancy. The field is a perfect match, but the type is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: A legal-adviser role requiring a legal qualification and practising experience the candidate does not hold (no qualifying law degree / GDL / SQE). The international-accountability subject is squarely on mission, but the qualification is an unmet essential.

jobs.title: OSINT Trainer and Safety Protocol Developer
jobs.reason: A "Trainer" and protocol-developer role requires established OSINT and safety-protocol expertise to teach others, which is well beyond the candidate's entry-level profile with no dedicated OSINT or security background. Though OSINT sits in a core interest zone, this is a specialist senior-practitioner position, not an entry role.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
jobs.reason: A purely speculative talent-pool posting with no concrete vacancy, which is excluded by policy. The organisation's mission fits perfectly, but there is no actual role to apply to.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks recognised experts on climate-justice criminalisation, which the candidate is not, and there is no indication of remuneration or a genuine vacancy at the candidate's level. Although human-rights and securitisation themes align with the candidate's interests, this is an expert/volunteer advisory position rather than an eligible paid job.
